name: Servyou Software Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Servyou Software Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial and tax information services in China. It operates through Digital Finance and Taxation Business; and Digital Government Affairs Business segments. The company offers taxation system development, operation, and maintenance to taxation authorities; and internet-based financial and tax services to taxpayers, and financial and taxation intermediaries under the YiQiYing brand.
